description: Get what Doconda found and did in a finished document (from create_document, review_document or edit_document). Returns problems_left: what is still wrong, with its severity (error, warning or info) and message; fixes: each automatic fix tried, applied or rejected, with the reason for a rejection; and for an edit, changes: each passage added, changed or removed, with the text before and after. Empty lists mean nothing is left or was tried. Call it after a review or an edit, or when a result says "see get_report"; for the status and download links use get_document. Until the document finishes it returns report_not_ready; once its retention ends, content_deleted.
name: get_report
title: Get report
